identificationModule.briefTitle: A Single-arm, Multicenter Exploratory Clinical Trial of Anlotinib Combined With TQB2450 and the SOX Regimen as First-line Treatment for Advanced Gastric Cancer With Low PD-L1 Expression
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Single-arm, Multicenter Exploratory Clinical Trial of Anlotinib Combined With TQB2450 and the SOX Regimen as First-line Treatment for Advanced Gastric Cancer With Low PD-L1 Expression

descriptionModule.briefSummary: To evaluate the efficacy and safety of anlotinib combined with TQB2450 and the SOX regimen as first-line treatment for advanced gastric cancer with low PD-L1 expression
descriptionModule.detailedDescription: Evaluation of the efficacy and safety of anlotinib in combination with TQB2450 and the SOX regimen as first-line treatment for advanced gastric cancer with low PD-L1 expression. Additionally, real-world data were collected from hospital-based patients receiving immune checkpoint inhibitor (ICI)-combined chemotherapy as first-line therapy for PD-L1-low advanced gastric cancer to establish an external control cohort. The efficacy outcomes between the two treatment strategies were then compared.

conditions: Advanced Gastric or Gastroesophageal Junction (G/GEJ) Adenocarcinoma

interventions.name: anlotinib +TQB2450 + Oxaliplatin+S-1
interventions.description:
Anlotinib: 10mg, po, d1-14,q3w,until disease progression or unacceptable toxicity.

TQB2450: 1200mg, iv, d1, q3w,until disease progression or unacceptable toxicity. Oxaliplatin: 130mg/㎡, iv, d1,6 cycles.

S-1:40mg, po, bid, d1\~14,6 cycles.

primaryOutcomes.description: The RECIST1.1 standards were used to evaluate the efficacy of drugs.
